description.en: Nineteen research and engineering skills run as one gated pipeline: each skill occupies a fixed stage, and a gate that fails blocks the skills downstream of it instead of passing its output along. The gates are falsifiable checks rather than flow control — atom conservation for chemical equations, CAS and unit validation for formulas, DOI resolution against Crossref, leakage detection on ml datasets, element checks on OBJ meshes — so a failed run names what failed instead of producing a plausible document. The four tools it registers drive the CLI: list the registry, run one skill, run the pipeline (with a dry run), and audit results/ for files no promotion accounts for. Requires Python 3.10+ on the host.
description.zh: 19 个科研与工程技能按固定阶段串成一条门控流水线：每个技能占一个阶段，某个门禁失败会阻断它下游的技能，而不是把结果继续往下传。门禁是可证伪的检查而非流程控制——化学方程式的原子守恒、公式的 CAS 与量纲校验、DOI 走 Crossref 核验、ML 数据集的泄漏检测、OBJ 网格的退化面检查——所以失败的运行会说清失败在哪，而不是产出一份看着像样的文档。注册的四个工具直接驱动 CLI：列出技能表、跑单个技能、跑流水线（可 dry run）、审 results/ 里没有 promotion 记录的文件。宿主需装 Python 3.10+。

description.en: Writing a novel of hundreds of thousands, even millions, of words with AI — but always worried it will forget earlier plot, characters and foreshadowing? Loading piles of old chapters into the context every time is not only costly; it also crowds out the room that should go to actual creation. Fade gives the AI a long-form memory that gradually fades: the recent plot stays sharp, the distant story keeps its key points, and important characters and events can be recalled whenever needed. When a chapter is finished, its memory is organized and its text archived automatically — no need to carry the whole novel around. Cut unnecessary token consumption, keep more context and budget for the chapters ahead, and let AI help you write a longer story.
description.zh: 想用 AI 写几十万字、上百万字的长篇小说，却总担心 AI 忘记前面的剧情、人物和伏笔？每次都把大量旧章节塞进上下文，不仅费钱，还会挤占真正用于创作的空间。「褪色」让 AI 拥有一套会逐渐淡化的长篇记忆：最近的剧情记得清楚，久远的故事保留重点，重要人物和事件随时可以找回。写完一章自动整理记忆、保存原文，不必反复携带整部小说。减少不必要的 Token 消耗，把更多上下文和预算留给后续创作，让 AI 陪你把故事写得更长。

description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加任务派发与一个工作台：主会话把任务派给独立的后台子会话、立即返回，子会话的报告自动回流成本会话的一条消息；侧边栏「派发工作台」显示并发位、排队、批次进度与失败原因，每条任务可取消、重试、归档。新增 10 个 dispatch_* 工具。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Extract reviewed workflow templates from workspace conversations, save them locally, import and export JSON, and submit parameterized runs to the current session. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 从工作区对话提炼并审阅工作流模板，支持本地保存、JSON 导入导出和向当前会话提交参数化任务。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Two-level plans with one sign-off path: plan_write records phases and sub-steps, complete_step closes one item at a time, wait_for_user declares a wait, abandon_plan drops the list, and a live panel shows the current item.
description.zh: 两级计划与唯一签核路径：plan_write 记录阶段与子步骤，complete_step 逐项签核，wait_for_user 声明等待，abandon_plan 放弃列表，面板实时显示当前项。

description.en: Quote one message from an earlier session into the composer as an inline quote, plus a quote action on each assistant reply; the quote is sent as a Markdown blockquote attached to the reply, so the model knows which message it answers.
description.zh: 在输入框里引用之前会话中的某一条消息（回复操作栏也有引用按钮），以引用条随提问发送，模型据此知道这条回复针对哪条内容。

description.en: Registers 45 software engineering workflow skills plus 11 callable pipeline tools (spec, plan, build, verify, review, ship, plus assess, catalog, skill, standup, incident) for the full path from requirements to release. Merges addyosmani/agent-skills (25) and mattpocock/skills (19), both MIT.
description.zh: 注册 45 个软件工程工作流技能，并提供 11 个可调用的流水线工具（spec、plan、build、verify、review、ship，另有 assess、catalog、skill、standup、incident），覆盖从需求到发布的完整路径。合并自 addyosmani/agent-skills（25 个）与 mattpocock/skills（19 个），均 MIT。

description.en: Lists the running DuMate desktop app's live model table in the DSH model selector, streams chat through it, and adds a loopback OpenAI-compatible gateway with a sidebar dashboard for status and local usage.
description.zh: 把本机运行中的 DuMate 接入 DSH：模型选择器里的实时模型表、流式对话、只绑回环的 OpenAI 兼容网关，以及显示状态与本地用量的右侧栏仪表盘。

description.en: Multi-agent investment committee for DSH - analyst, bull, bear, risk and PM debate where every claim carries an evidence tag, abstention (PASS) is a first-class verdict, Buffett/Munger/Lynch/Wood guest seats critique the debate itself, and zero-key market data (CBOE quote/K-line/options-IV + SEC 10-K + nasdaq news, Yahoo-free) feeds an auditable IC-MEMO - 6 to 10 model calls per session.
description.zh: 多智能体投研议院：分析师→多方→空方→风控→组合经理辩论，主张全带证据标签、PASS 弃权一等公民，巴菲特/芒格/林奇/伍德客座评辩（会真实分裂），零 key 行情（CBOE 报价/K线/期权隐含波动 + SEC 10-K + nasdaq 新闻，绕开雅虎限流）喂给可审计的 IC-MEMO——一场 6-10 次调用约 40 秒。

description.en: Experimental one-hand gesture control for DSH sessions; requires the Windows Desktop 0.12.1 media-permission patch and Harness 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 用单手手势操作 DSH 会话的实验插件；需 Windows Desktop 0.12.1 媒体权限补丁和 Harness 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Adds a Windows-native screenshot button to the DSH composer with area, window and full-screen modes, an optional delay, and automatic import into the current chat draft. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框工具栏加一个 Windows 原生截图按钮，支持区域、窗口、全屏与延迟，截完自动加入当前聊天草稿。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Route independent tasks to DSH, Codex, Kimi Code, or Antigravity subagents using configurable natural-language rules, with resumable sessions and a shared task panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 按可配置的自然语言规则将独立任务派发给 DSH、Codex、Kimi Code 或 Antigravity 子代理，支持会话续接和统一任务面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Composer-dock strip: the selected model's balance (topped-up plus granted) or its rolling 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows across DeepSeek account and API, Moonshot, Kimi Coding, Zhipu and GLM Coding — read from DSH credentials, with the key never leaving the Host. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 输入框上方额度条：跟随当前模型显示余额（充值 + 赠金）或 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月用量窗口，覆盖 DeepSeek 账号与 API、Moonshot、Kimi Coding、智谱、GLM Coding；数据取自 DSH 本地凭据，密钥不出 Host。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A desk pet for the DSH web GUI whose illustration follows the current model's reasoning effort across five stages, taken from one of three art sets that auto-select for Claude and DeepSeek models. Draggable and collapsible, with a custom image per stage, and it also fills in reasoning-effort levels for custom model providers in Settings → Models. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的桌宠：形象随当前模型的思考强度在五档之间切换，龙女仆／Claude／DeepSeek 三套立绘按模型自动选择；可拖动、可收起，每一档都能换成自己的图片，并为自定义服务商补上「设置 → 模型」里的思考强度档位。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Native scene agents and bilingual management for DeepSeek Harness, with explicit model policy and scoped tools.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上原生场景智能体，支持中英双语管理、明确模型策略和限定范围工具。

description.en: Self-hosted semantic layer for DeepSeek Harness — NL data questions where metric calibers ride with every result; single-SELECT guard, zero-dep PostgreSQL wire client, and a zero-config --weknora bridge: ask your WeKnora anything.
description.zh: 用自然语言问数据，每个结果都附带指标口径，自带语义层和 SQL 自愈。

description.en: antigravity破甲 · Antigravity armor-break kit（hooks + TLS relay）+ DeepSeek Harness 补丁包（9 patches, drift=0）
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 打九个补丁，配好 hooks 和 TLS 中继，做破甲与红队研究。

description.en: Apple HIG design-review skill wrapper for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 按苹果 HIG 规范帮你审查跨平台 UI/UX 设计，指出界面问题并给出改进建议。

description.en: 7+2聊天框架公开版｜连接DSH与OneBot，可选接入Codex Peer
description.zh: 把 DSH 和 OneBot 连起来，让 AI 机器人能在 QQ 上收发消息聊天，还能选配 Codex Peer。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: live peak/off-peak price clock, token usage and cost, account balance, notifications, and RTL — with a self-updating schedule.
description.zh: 实时显示 DeepSeek API 高峰/低谷价格时钟，统计 token 用量与花费、账户余额，支持通知提醒和 RTL 界面。

description.en: Adds quit and check/update controls to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, plus an optional KDE tray, per-feature settings, remembered window size, and safe cache cleanup.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面增加退出与检查/更新控件，并提供可选的 KDE 托盘、分项设置、记住窗口大小和安全缓存清理。

description.en: Web UI chime for DeepSeek Harness tool-permission approval requests, with burst coalescing and full cleanup.
description.zh: 工具权限审批请求一到，Web UI 就响铃提醒，还能合并连续请求并自动清理。

description.en: DSH plugin: record every task run as readable Markdown - system prompt, model calls, tool calls, TTFT. 把 DSH 一轮任务的全过程记录成可读的 Markdown。
description.zh: 把 DSH 每轮任务的系统提示、模型调用、工具往返和 TTFT 全记录成可读 Markdown，方便回看和排查。

description.en: Bilibili tools for DeepSeek Harness: 27 tools for account reads, preview-gated writes, and two-stage video evidence (subtitles, danmaku, frames, ASR). Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 B 站工具：27 个工具，覆盖账号读取、预览后才写入的操作，以及分两阶段的视频证据（字幕、弹幕、画面、ASR）。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Ephemeral side questions in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: answered from the current conversation, counted separately, and discarded on close.
description.zh: 在右侧栏随时问点题外话，答案只基于当前对话，单独计数，关掉就清空。

description.en: 草料二维码 DeepSeek Harness 插件：OAuth 连接、场景 Skill 与 Registry 材料
description.zh: 在对话里直接建二维码、管表单、看巡检记录，草料二维码一键接入 Harness。

description.en: Adds Codex (ChatGPT subscription) models to DeepSeek Harness as a model row, calling the Codex /responses endpoint directly with the local Codex CLI OAuth credential, and shows the official usage windows as a quota pill under the composer. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 Codex（ChatGPT 订阅）模型作为模型行接入 DeepSeek Harness：直接调用 Codex /responses 端点、复用本机 Codex CLI 的 OAuth 凭据，并在输入框下方显示官方返回的用量窗口胶囊。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Choose your own configured model and reasoning effort for DeepSeek Harness Auto Review.

Dataset documentation for DeepSeek Harness: bounded CSV/TSV/JSON/JSONL profiling (types, missingness, cardinality), redacted PII detection by column name and value pattern (emails, phones, national IDs, IPs), a Datasheet-style card with missing-section warnings, Markdown/JSON/SARIF output and REP evidence that stores the analysis but never the raw
description.zh: 给数据集自动生成说明卡，顺便按列名和脱敏值模式揪出邮箱、手机号等个人信息。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a live CNY cost estimate for the chat you are reading, priced with DeepSeek's peak / off-peak rates.
description.zh: 在聊天界面实时显示当前会话花了多少人民币，按 DeepSeek 峰谷价算，一眼看清今天花了多少钱。

description.en: DeepSeek 余额 + 本轮/今日/本周/本月/累计花费，常驻 DSH 输入框下方 | Balance & spend dock for DeepSeek Harness
在 DeepSeek Harness 左侧栏嵌一个 chat.deepseek.com 网页版：登录一次自动记住，切回来还在原来的对话。
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏直接嵌入 DeepSeek 网页版，登录一次就记住，切回来还是原来的对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：检测模型思考段的复读退化并自动打断、自动续跑。通用重复检测，不依赖白名单。
description.zh: 盯着模型思考段，发现复读就自动打断并续跑，不用手动点继续。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏视觉设计插件：84 套品牌设计语言的风格库，按风格生成网页 / 幻灯片 / 信息图
description.zh: 侧栏内置 84 套品牌设计语言，一键按风格生成网页、幻灯片和信息图。

description.en: Data-management-plan tooling for DeepSeek Harness: a ten-section scaffold with prompts, completeness/consistency checks (datasets, personal data, open-sharing conflicts, retention minimum, backup, repository/license/DOI, contact), Markdown/JSON/SARIF export. Checks are internal consistency checks, not funder-template certification; no network, no f
description.zh: 帮你搭好十节数据管理计划，自动查漏补缺，管住数据存放、访问权限和授权到期后的去向。

description.en: drillr for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): financial data and research tools for US, Japan and China A-share equities via drillr's hosted MCP server.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接查美股、日股和 A 股的财报与金融数据，做投研更省事。

description.en: 百度搭子 DuMate 个人会员的 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件：22 个模型进选择器，Cookie 登录、多账号故障切换、余额查询与每日自动签到。Native Baidu DuMate provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
DSH 插件：三轴情绪状态 + 思考轨迹打点（E/S/P，四态、形状、种子冷启动）
description.zh: 把每轮对话读成 E/S/P 三条情绪曲线，分状态、按形状归类，帮你追踪情绪与思考轨迹。

description.en: 中文基金申请书检查（DeepSeek Harness）：19 项起步清单（项目名称/摘要/科学问题属性 A-D/立项依据/目标/内容/方案/技术路线/创新/可行性/基础/条件/团队/预算/预算说明/伦理/数据共享/限项/参考文献），预算算术与结构校验（设备费/业务费/劳务费/间接费用，合计一致性），申请材料包扫描（申请书/预算表/伦理/承诺书/简历/附件），输出 JSON/Markdown 与 REP 证据。关键词清单，不是评审结论。
description.zh: 投稿前检查中文基金申请书：19项清单、预算算术和材料包一次扫清，输出JSON/Markdown报告。

description.en: Ethics-application checklist for DeepSeek Harness: 18-item keyword checklist (title, PI, purpose, design, participants, recruitment, consent, assent, risks, benefits, confidentiality, vulnerable groups, compensation, conflicts, retention, dissemination, animal ethics, biosafety), an advisory risk level with required safeguards from structured flags
description.zh: 按18项关键词清单核对伦理申请材料，提前找出还缺哪些核心声明，并给出风险等级和防护建议。
在左侧栏加个 Jira 看板，把你名下没做完的事项按优先级排好，一眼看清先干哪个。

description.en: Adds one row to the DeepSeek Harness workspace menu: move this workspace to the top, once. No favorites, pins or auto-sorting; no runtime dependencies, no saved state. MIT.
description.zh: 在工作区菜单里点一下，就能把该工作区挪到侧边栏最上面，只排一次，不搞收藏也不自动排序。

description.en: View KiCad schematics and PCBs side by side with local KiCanvas rendering and optional routing through separately installed KiCad and Freerouting tools.
description.zh: 并排查看 KiCad 原理图与 PCB，使用本地 KiCanvas 渲染，并可调用另行安装的 KiCad 和 Freerouting 工具进行自动布线。

description.en: Pi agent preset with a Pi-style prompt, Pi coding tools, non-blocking Bash, and DSH skills and goals, running with full access.
description.zh: Pi 智能体预设，提供 Pi 风格提示词、Pi 编程工具、非阻塞 Bash 和 DSH 技能及目标工具，以 Full access 权限运行。

description.en: 把地点数据变成可分享的 My Earth 交互地图的 DeepSeek Harness 插件（公开测试版）。Public-beta DSH bundle with a create_map tool.
description.zh: 跟 agent 说一句话，就能把地点数据变成可分享的交互地图，做攻略、做清单都方便。

description.en: Clears the DSH desktop "plugin is in use, the desktop app will not remove it right now" refusal and finishes the marketplace update.
description.zh: 清掉桌面端「插件正在使用中」的拒绝提示，把市场没做完的更新或卸载一次搞定。

description.en: Workspace file search, editing, creation, and replacement for DSH Desktop.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供工作区文件搜索、编辑、创建和替换功能。

description.en: 本地出稿工作台 + DSH 插件：模型用 post_facts 抓带 source_url 的真实事实（bioRxiv DOI / 2HAI 版本 / npm 包 / URL），自己写中英双语推文与卡片图，你手动复制到 X。不发推、不调 X API、零依赖。 ｜ A local draft desk for DeepSeek Harness: sourced facts in, EN + ZH posts and a card out — you paste it into X yourself. No X API, no credentials, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里说一句「我刚发了…」，它就抓带来源的真实事实、写好中英双语推文和卡片图，你手动复制去发。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的全局快捷键截图：任意界面按快捷键框选，截图直接进当前会话输入框
description.zh: 任意界面按快捷键框选截图，直接进当前会话输入框，省去切窗口和拖文件。

description.en: Seven research SOP skills for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上七套科研标准流程技能，每步都产出记录或明确结论，不做空谈。

description.en: One-command research suite bundle + research_doctor for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 一条命令装齐研究全家桶，还能顺手体检证据库是否健康。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：手机连局域网就能控制这台电脑上的 DSH 工作区（接着聊、投任务、看执行）；也是侧边栏角色卡，粘一张卡就开演，支持链接/PNG 卡导入、AI 扩写与小说分章推进。
description.zh: 手机连同一 WiFi 就能遥控电脑上的 DSH 工作区，还能粘张角色卡直接开演。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：侧栏会话操作——标为未读、永久删除已归档会话 / Session actions for DeepSeek Harness: mark unread, delete archived sessions
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单里加操作：把会话标为未读，或彻底删掉已归档的会话。

description.en: Session Autospace - Start a conversation without picking a workspace.
description.zh: 不用先选工作区，直接开聊，每个对话自动在 ~/DSH 下分到独立文件夹和沙盒。

description.en: 在会话右键菜单（和标题栏）加一个「删除对话」：真的把会话日志（session.vN.jsonl.zstd）从磁盘删掉，并刷新侧栏列表。DSH 原生只有「归档」（可恢复的隐藏）。
description.zh: 给会话右键菜单加个「删除对话」，把日志从磁盘真正删掉，不再只是归档隐藏。

description.en: DSH 侧边助理：右侧栏里的中文助理，把需求说清楚后转达给主会话，并跟进它的进展
description.zh: 在右侧栏加个中文助理，帮你把需求问清楚、整理成任务再转给主会话，并盯着进展。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: auto-load the matching installed skill from the user's message, no trigger word needed.
description.zh: 不用触发词，按你的消息自动匹配并加载已装技能，还能在侧栏勾选哪些技能可自动加载。

description.en: DSH plugin: turn past sessions into two bilingual tables of the tools and data sources you actually used. 从历史会话提炼工具与数据源清单：分类、优缺点、可直接打开的网址。
description.zh: 把历史会话里真正用过的工具和数据源整理成两张中英双语清单，带分类、优缺点和可直接打开的网址。

description.en: Recompute the statistics reported in a manuscript and flag self-inconsistent p values for DeepSeek Harness: APA-style t/F/chi-square/r/z parsing, two-tailed and upper-tail p values from zero-dependency distributions, CI-versus-p checks, exact character locators, Markdown and SARIF 2.1.0 output, and a REP v1 evidence record. Arithmetic, not accusati
description.zh: 重算论文里的 t/F/卡方/r/z 统计量，揪出前后对不上的 p 值，帮你核对数据是否自洽。

description.en: DSH 字数统计工具：中文按字、西文按词，另给标点/字符/字素/行数与 UTF-8 字节，并可用 min/max 区间判定是否达标。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加个靠谱的字数统计，中文字、西文词、标点行数都能数，还能按区间判断是否达标。

description.en: Observes detected background download commands and renders live cards with bytes, speed and ETA; silent downloads get a total from a HEAD probe. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 观察识别到的后台下载命令并显示实时进度卡片（字节、速度、剩余时间）；静默下载用 HEAD 探测总量。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Richer Windows tray menu for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-item icons, restart, update check, and a light/dark theme submenu.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Windows 托盘菜单加上图标、重启、检查更新和明暗主题切换，用起来更顺手。

description.en: 点选前端页面任意 UI 控件，自动把控件详情（CSS 选择器/XPath/组件名/样式）写入 DeepSeek Harness 输入框，让 AI 精准定位要改的界面元素。
description.zh: 点一下网页上的控件，自动把选择器、组件名和样式填进输入框，让 AI 精准找到要改的地方。

description.en: See your balance and conversation cost right inside DSH window
description.zh: 在 DSH 窗口里直接查看 API 余额和当前会话（含子代理）花了多少钱。

description.en: In a folder that has already been used for a task, the model still reads its contents when the next task starts, which can mix up the context, add thinking overhead and spend extra tokens. This plugin creates a fresh empty folder after every completed task, pins it to the top of the workspace for the next task, and renames the finished folder after the task content. Everything runs locally and is safe and reliable.
description.zh: 在一个文件夹里执行过任务后，开始下一个任务时模型仍会查看该文件夹内的内容，可能造成上下文混乱、思考量过多、额外消耗 token 等；本插件在每次完成任务后生成一个新的空文件夹并置顶在工作区等待调用，原文件夹会根据任务内容命名，全程在本地执行，安全可靠。

description.en: Read-only Zotero bridge for DeepSeek Harness (Local API + sqlite copy)
description.zh: 只读连接本地 Zotero 文献库，把选中的论文登记为证据条目，方便研究引用。

description.en: 传染病现场流行病学调查报告（流调报告）撰写技能 + DeepSeek Harness 插件：有限信息可出稿，缺项分级，自动配图，直出 Word/PDF/Markdown

DSH 设置新增「归档」页：按工作区分组查看已归档会话，支持筛选/排序、取消归档、二次确认彻底删除。Add an Archive page to DSH Settings: view archived sessions grouped by workspace, filter/sort, unarchive, and permanently delete one or all with confirmation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置里加个归档页，按工作区分组管理已归档会话，可筛选排序、取消归档或彻底删除。

description.en: Telegram control plane for DeepSeek Harness — one group per workspace, one forum topic per session.
description.zh: 在手机上用 Telegram 群组和话题直接操控 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区和会话，随时远程干活。

description.en: Session alerts, safe deletion of archived sessions (optionally to the Recycle Bin), batch cleanup, and leftover-file cleanup for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供会话提醒、归档会话的安全删除（可选移入回收站）、批量清理和遗留文件清理。

description.en: Floating HUD for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: live session token speed, input/output/total token counts and cache hit rate, DeepSeek account balance, and per-model cost estimates in a draggable, resizable panel.
description.zh: 浮在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面上的 HUD：实时显示会话 Token 速度、输入/输出/总量与缓存命中率、DeepSeek 账户余额，以及按模型估算的费用；面板可拖动、可缩放。

description.en: Trae CN as a native DeepSeek Harness LLM provider: browser OAuth login by default, an opt-in local-install credential source, and an OpenAI-compatible surface on the host web server.
description.zh: 把 Trae CN 接进 DSH 当原生模型用，浏览器登录即可，还能开个 OpenAI 兼容接口给别的客户端。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 素材浏览插件：按工作区查看 MUSE AV 素材与出图记录，复制素材直链。DSH asset browser for MUSE AV workspaces, image libraries and generation history.

A consent-gated personal profile store: people are indexed by name, entries by person and key, and no profile record is read before the current session is authorised. Sensitive entries come back masked unless the user authorises that tier separately; credential-like values are refused at write time. Ages and next birthdays are computed at read time, so asOf restores the answer for a past date, and facts that rot (height, weight, address) carry freshness warnings. Five profile_* tools plus a settings page to browse, edit, delete and revoke grants.
description.zh: 带授权的本地个人信息库：以姓名为索引存人，以「姓名 + 条目」取值，未获当次会话授权不会读取任何档案。敏感条目（证件、银行卡、住址、健康）默认掩码，凭证类数据写入时直接拒收；年龄和下次生日一律查询时现算，asOf 能复原过去某天的答案，身高体重住址这类会过期的条目带新鲜度提醒。提供五个 profile_* 工具和设置页，可浏览、编辑、删除与撤销授权。

description.en: Delegate subtasks from DeepSeek Harness to Herdr-managed coding agents, harvest exact results, and review them in DSH.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的子任务派给 Herdr 管理的编码代理，拿回准确结果并在 DSH 里直接审阅。

description.en: Adds header buttons that move a started session into another workspace and switch the Agent preset of a session that already began.
description.zh: 在会话头部添加按钮，可把已开始的会话迁移到另一个工作区，或切换已开始会话的 Agent 预设。

description.en: Replaces the summarizing context compactor with a handoff note the model writes itself and a fresh window that keeps only the system prompt, the note, and the current turn.
description.zh: 用模型自写的交接便签替代摘要式上下文压缩：换窗后只保留系统提示、便签与当前 turn，并提供预算感知与归档回查。

description.en: Companion-AI hot/cold memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto dialogue archive, graduated cooling, cue-gated recall, 1600-token memory snapshot. ｜ 陪伴 AI 冷热分层记忆：全自动归档 + 渐进冷存 + 线索召回。
description.zh: 给陪伴 AI 加上冷热分层记忆，自动归档对话、渐进冷存、按线索召回，省 token 不忘事。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 里打开完整的 CPAMC 管理界面 · Open the full CPAMC console inside dsh
description.zh: 装个插件就能在 DSH 里打开完整的 CPAMC 管理界面，轻松配置和管理多个模型来源。

description.en: Agent profiles for DSH: per-session persona, duties, avatar and long-term memory, injected as a system-prompt section.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的每个会话配上专属 AI 角色，人设、头像、说话风格和长期记忆都能自定义。

description.en: TangSan mascot appearance layer for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: wears a generated TangSan portrait as the GUI background (surface-token fade with opacity, blur, scrim and position controls), seats the matching square avatar as the sidebar and conversation brand mark, and edits it all from a Settings section; the host serves the artwork and config locally under /api/tangsan, and the config lives at $DSH_HOME/tangsan.json.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页端的唐三美化形象插件：把生成的唐三插画铺成界面背景（表面令牌淡出，配合不透明度、模糊、遮罩与位置调节），将同系列方形头像换到侧栏与会话标题的品牌标识位，并在设置页统一配置；素材与配置由宿主在 /api/tangsan 下本地提供，配置文件位于 $DSH_HOME/tangsan.json。

description.en: DeepSeek 账户控制台：实时余额监控 / 用量与成本统计 / 消费额度管理 / 全局悬浮 HUD（官方 API 直连，Key 仅存本机）
Connects DeepSeek Harness agents to Nia Teams group chats with two-way messages, per-chat sessions, and human approval cards.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 智能体接入 Nia Teams 群聊，支持双向消息、独立群聊会话和人工审批卡片。

description.en: A composer badge that shows whether DeepSeek API usage bills at the peak or off-peak rate right now, and on click the price table for that window: input cache hit, input cache miss and output, in CNY per million tokens, for FLASH and PRO. It sits in the statistics row under the composer right of the context meter, and in the New Session options row. The schedule follows the official pricing page — Beijing time, Monday to Friday except Chinese statutory holidays, 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 peak, weekends and holidays off-peak all day — with statutory holiday data for 2026 and 2027. One timer fires at the next boundary instead of polling. Client-only, no network requests, no dependencies.
description.zh: 输入框底部徽标：实时显示 DeepSeek API 当前按峰时还是闲时计费，点击弹出该时段的价目表——输入缓存命中、输入缓存未命中、输出，元/百万 tokens，分 FLASH 与 PRO 两列。位置在输入框下方统计行、内置「上下文已用」右侧，新会话时在输入框上方选项行。时段遵循官方定价页：北京时间周一至周五（法定节假日除外）09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00 为峰时，周末与法定节假日全天闲时；内置 2026、2027 年法定节假日数据。只在下一个时段边界装一个定时器，不做轮询。纯客户端插件，不发网络请求、无依赖。

description.en: An Eisenhower-matrix to-do panel for the DSH sidebar: importance × urgency quadrants that fill the panel, inline quick-add with a hand-drawn due-date calendar, drag to reorder or move between quadrants, a draggable center handle for quadrant proportions, one-click switch to the completed view, and random encouragement toasts that tell praised on-time finishes apart from overdue ones. Minimal styling uses only DSH theme tokens; bilingual UI.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的艾森豪威尔矩阵待办面板：重要 × 紧急四象限自动撑满面板，象限内 就地新增并自带自绘截止日期日历，拖动可在象限内排序或跨象限移动，拖动中心 圆点调整四象限比例，一键切换到「已完成」，完成时按按期/逾期给出不同的随机 鼓励浮窗。极简风，只用 DSH 主题 token，界面中英双语。

description.en: Audio and video player that lives in the DSH sidebar: video (mp4/webm/mov/m4v/ogv) and audio (mp3/wav/flac/ogg/opus/m4a/aac) open in a sidebar tab with same-name subtitles and a draggable seek bar, while a panel with QQ Music and local music tabs adds a turntable, a live spectrum (bars or wave), a pitch readout (note name, Hz, cents) and lyrics with word-by-word timing, five effects and two layouts. One control row in a single style holds 18 candidate buttons (at most 17 on screen) for favourites, loop (order, single, shuffle), rate 0.5-2, subtitles and a 6 to 10 column grid. The QQ Music side covers search, charts, playlists and new songs, and favourites are written to the same liked list the signed-in account sees instead of a local flag. The local side scans a folder, accepts drag and drop and reads items as whole files so seeking works. A capsule bar docks above the input box, sits at the bottom or hides, and its buttons map onto panel controls through one shared store. Defaults: capsule above the input box, 10 columns, rainbow lyrics, order loop, spectrum on, two-line lyrics, bars. The QQ Music interface is unofficial and only the desktop profile is verified. It is a third-party fan tool, not a Tencent product, plays only your own library, joins no official campaign, and is removed on an infringement notice. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把音视频播放器搬进 DSH 侧边栏：视频（mp4/webm/mov/m4v/ogv）与音频（mp3/wav/flac/ogg/opus/m4a/aac）在侧边栏页签里打开，自动加载同名字幕、进度条可拖动；面板分 QQ音乐 与本地音乐两个页签，上方是唱盘、实时频谱（柱状或波形）、音准读数（音名、频率、音分）与歌词，有逐字时间轴时按逐字、没有时按整行，含五种动效与两种版式；控件行统一风格，18 枚候选按钮同屏至多 17 枚，涵盖收藏、循环三态（顺序／单曲／随机）、0.5–2 倍速、字幕与 6–10 列网格。QQ音乐侧覆盖搜索、榜单、歌单与新歌，收藏写回登录账号本人的「我喜欢」，不是本地标记；本地侧扫描目录、支持拖放，音频整文件读取所以拖动进度可用。胶囊播放条可停靠输入框上方、页面底部或隐藏，按钮与面板控件共用一份 store 一一对应。默认值：胶囊在输入框上方、10 列、歌词炫彩、顺序循环、频谱开、两句歌词、柱状。QQ音乐接口为非官方接口，仅在桌面端 profile 验证。本插件为第三方爱好者工具，非 QQ 音乐官方产品；仅播放自己账号的列表，不参与官方活动，收到侵权通知即删库。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Archives your own material from 27 platforms into one local knowledge base. Every row carries an official entry link where one exists (20 of 27) and guidance for what to do after the login page (84 steps across all 27 rows). 8 rows take a pasted credential in a box that the plugin itself writes to $DSH_HOME/_secrets, showing only a masked preview afterwards. 7 rows (11 pages) are read directly by a controlled browser the plugin launches with its own profile over CDP, so a logged-in page such as the Douyin creator centre can be archived without copy-paste; a page that is still a login wall is reported and never archived. Capabilities that other tools usually supply by asking you to install a package are built in instead, with zero third-party dependencies: link-to-Markdown with an https/private-network gate that re-checks the URL after redirects, WeRead highlight export, Cubox sync, and an IMAP client that uses BODY.PEEK so your mail is never marked read. Text is stored on disk, large media is kept as a pointer with a text shadow, every record is indexed with a unified schema and can be deleted again. Registers 17 agent tools. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把你自己各平台账号的资料汇聚进本地知识库。27 条数据源中，有官方入口的 20 条带一键跳转按钮，27 条全部带「登录之后怎么做」的分步引导（共 84 步）。8 条源提供凭据粘贴框，保存由插件写进 $DSH_HOME/_secrets，之后只回显打码预览。7 条源共 11 个页面可由插件自己启动的受控浏览器读取——独立 profile、走 CDP，抖音创作者中心这类已登录页面不用再复制粘贴；读到的仍是登录墙会如实报告且不归档。别的工具通常要你装个包才有的能力，这里全部实现在插件本体、零第三方依赖：链接转 Markdown（仅 https、拒内网、重定向后复查地址）、微信读书划线导出、Cubox 收藏同步，以及用 BODY.PEEK 收信因此不会把你的邮件标成已读的 IMAP 客户端。文字资料落盘，大素材只存指针并生成文字影子，归档记录按统一 schema 索引，每条都能撤回删除。注册 17 个模型工具。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Media conversion panel for DSH: video and audio format conversion, clip trimming, and video-to-GIF, with every output checked for resolution, codec, framerate, duration, channels and sample rate.
description.zh: DSH 的媒体转换面板：视频/音频格式互转、裁剪片段、取段做 GIF，每件产物核对分辨率、编码、帧率、时长、声道与采样率。

description.en: Theme manager for the DSH Web GUI: fifteen Nyx-series dark themes (Vitesse, Vitesse Emerald, Catppuccin Mocha, Lilac Soft, Visual Studio Dark, Neutral Slate, Inkstone Xuanmo, Inkstone Canghai, Misty Teal, Aurora, Verdant Soft, Fields of the Shire, Gruvbox, Flexoki Dark, OpenChamber) with preview cards on a dedicated Themes page in Settings; selection persists in localStorage. Web GUI only; requires DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 or later.
description.zh: Web 界面主题管理器：内置 15 套 Nyx 系列深色主题（流光夜、翡翠夜、摩卡夜、丁香夜、视界夜、岩灰夜、玄墨夜、苍海夜、雾青夜、极光夜、青翠夜、牧野夜、复古夜、朱墨夜、暖阁夜），在设置中提供带效果预览的独立「主题」页面，选择结果保存在浏览器 localStorage。仅面向 Web GUI，需要 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 及以上。

description.en: Host half of lil-whale: a file-backed shared pond for several DeepSeek Harness agents, with one group chat and DM ledger, message-driven wake-ups that respect each fish's sleep window, per-member cursors and a rename ledger. Both packages are required: this host half plus @fabianactor/dsh-lil-whale-group-ui, which draws the sidebar panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 小小肥鱼的宿主半：几条 DeepSeek Harness agent 共用一个鱼塘，群聊与私聊都是文件账本，按消息唤醒并尊重每条鱼的睡眠窗，每成员有游标、改名有账本。两个包必须一起装：这个宿主半，加上负责侧边栏面板的 @fabianactor/dsh-lil-whale-group-ui。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Sidebar panel of lil-whale: group chat and DMs between the host and the fish, unread badges, image attachments, and a pond page that starts or stops each agent. Both packages are required: this panel plus @fabianactor/dsh-lil-whale-group as the host half. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 小小肥鱼的面板：宿主与几条鱼之间的群聊和私聊、未读红点、图片附件，以及开关每条鱼的鱼塘页。两个包必须一起装：这个面板，加上作为宿主半的 @fabianactor/dsh-lil-whale-group。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Query Honkai: Star Rail data as agent tools: character stats, skills, Light Cones, relic sets and current endgame stages. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 以工具形式查询《崩坏：星穹铁道》数据：角色属性、技能、光锥、遗器套装与当前深渊关卡。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Local Chrome control: list tabs, snapshot pages, navigate, screenshot, fill forms and evaluate JS over a loopback bridge.
description.zh: 本地 Chrome 操控：标签页列表、页面快照、导航、截图、填表与 JS 取值，走回环桥。

description.en: In-UI panel that opens chat.deepseek.com inside the Harness Web UI through a Host-side loopback proxy, keeping the DeepSeek login across restarts and importing the login state of WeChat-only accounts. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 Harness 网页界面内用浮层面板打开 chat.deepseek.com，经 Host 端回环代理转发，跨重启保留 DeepSeek 登录态，并可从正式站点导入微信账号的登录态。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Draw paper figures as SVG the way top venues draw them, lint them against layout rules, edit them on a sidebar canvas, and export vector PDF or editable draw.io. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把论文里的想法画成顶会风格的 SVG 插图，按排版规矩自动体检，在侧栏画布上直接改，最后导出矢量 PDF 与可编辑 draw.io。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: ZenTao panel for DSH: reads the requirements, tasks and bugs assigned to you through REST v1/v2 or the official zentao-cli, dispatches an agent on a branch you name, and writes a state transition back after showing the exact request.
description.zh: DSH 的禅道面板：通过 REST v1/v2 或官方 zentao-cli 读取指派给你的需求、任务与 Bug，在你指定的分支上派发 Agent，并在展示请求原文后把状态流转回写禅道。

description.en: Draws a parent session's subagent sessions as an indented subtree in the left sidebar, and ships a Router/Worker mode: the coordinator hands out work as tickets, tickets persist to SQLite, queue against the host's concurrency limit, deliver results back to the parent conversation, and get swept when a worker goes silent. The subtree reads only the host's data-row-key and parent/child relation, never modifies the host row, and sizes itself from the theme font token.
description.zh: 在左侧会话列表里把子代理会话画成父会话的缩进子树，并自带「Router 项目经理模式」：协调者按工单派活，工单落 SQLite、按宿主并发上限排队、结果回流到主会话、worker 静默卡死时自动收尾。子树只读宿主的 data-row-key 与父子关系，不修改宿主行，缩进按主题字号计算。

description.en: Zhihu and web dual-source search in DeepSeek Harness, with cited answers and a built-in plugin review topic. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中同时检索知乎与全网，提供带引用的回答和插件评价专题。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Tiana panel for DeepSeek Harness: deploy the web app, SQLite database or backend API built in a session to TianaCloud and get a public URL, browse and clone app templates with sandboxed preview and local hot reload, and manage published sites per space. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏中的 Tiana 面板：把会话里做好的网页应用、SQLite 数据库或后端 API 部署到 TianaCloud 并拿到可访问网址；可浏览并克隆应用模板（沙箱 iframe 预览、本地热更新），并按空间管理已发布的站点。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Shows the current public IP with its location, provider, ASN and local network interfaces, as a composer line or a draggable floating card. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在输入框下方或悬浮窗里显示当前公网 IP、归属地、运营商、ASN 与本地网卡，字号跟随 Harness 设置。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Plugin load audit for your installed set. `/diet` prints one card: context tokens per request, hot-path host time outside the tool body, listener fan-out per plugin, and which three plugins to look at first, plus per-tool context pricing. Reads the running event bus and tool registry only, never patches another plugin, writes no files and makes no network calls. The card states its boundary: rc.7 exposes no per-listener timing, so the cut list is fan-out, not per-plugin milliseconds.
description.zh: DSH 插件税体检。`/diet` 输出一张卡片：每次请求的工具定义占多少 token、热路径上工具体之外的宿主耗时、每个插件在热路径上挂了多少监听器、先看哪三个插件，另附逐工具上下文成本。只读运行中的事件总线与工具注册表，不修改其他插件，不写文件，不发网络请求。卡片写明边界：rc.7 没有逐监听器耗时接口，“先拆谁”给的是监听器扇出，不是逐插件毫秒数。

description.en: Native inline media player for the dsh web chat: the media_show tool mints short-lived host-served URLs and the client renders playable cards for mp4, webm, gif and animated webp, so generated video plays inside the conversation. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH Web 对话里的原生内联媒体播放器：media_show 工具签发短时效本地链接，客户端直接渲染可播放卡片，支持 mp4、webm、gif 与动图 webp，生成的视频在会话内播放。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Organize unarchived conversations in batches and share named title templates across workspaces.
description.zh: 批量整理未归档会话标题，并在多个工作区之间复用可命名的标题模板。

description.en: Highlights the active session's name in the DSH sidebar with a flowing iridescent gradient and continuously marquees long titles to reveal their full text.
description.zh: 为左侧会话列表中当前活动会话的名字加上不停滑动的彩色流光渐变，并让过长的标题走马灯滚动、始终展示完整内容。

description.en: Security-audit skill for DeepSeek Harness: guided reviews, coverage-led codebase audits, structured findings, and report validators.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的安全审查技能：引导式审查、带覆盖账本的全库审计、结构化问题记录和报告校验器。

description.en: A dsh plugin for mechanical CAD, where the agent generates and the plugin closes the loop — fit, motion and manufacturability checked before you accept a model, with the final call left to you.
description.zh: dsh 的机械 CAD 插件：Agent 负责生成，插件负责闭环——验收前做配合、运动与可制造性检查，最终判断留给你。

description.en: Windows taskbar unread badge and completion chime for DeepSeek Harness turns.
description.zh: 在 Windows 任务栏显示未读角标，并在 DeepSeek Harness 回合完成时播放提示音。

description.en: Runs ZCode .dwf.ts dynamic workflows in DeepSeek Harness with persistent named subagents, sandboxed workspace helpers, a resumable SQLite run journal, and a ZCode-style sidebar panel for live traces, subagents, artifacts, configuration and resume.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中运行 ZCode .dwf.ts 动态工作流：可持续对话的具名子代理、沙箱工作区能力、可续跑的 SQLite 运行日志，以及 ZCode 风格的右侧栏面板（实时轨迹、子代理、产物、配置与续跑）。

description.en: Review answered questions in DeepSeek Harness (DSH): keep all options, selected answers, and free text visible, including dsh-choice cards.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）中回看已回答的问题：保留全部选项、已选答案和自由填写内容，并支持 dsh-choice 卡片。

description.en: DeepSeek balance monitoring with two-tier low-balance alerts pushed to Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram and other IM channels; key-free host accounts are supported when the built-in account service is available and signed in.
description.zh: DeepSeek 余额监控与两级低余额告警，推送到飞书、钉钉、企微、Telegram 等 IM 通道；支持宿主账号免填 API Key（需已登录）。

description.en: Image preview with real zoom, pan, rotation and full screen in the right-Sidebar document preview and the conversation lightbox.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的图片预览补上缩放、拖动、旋转与全屏：右侧栏文档预览和对话图片灯箱共用一套查看器。

description.en: A launch bar above the composer: one button per launcher a project declares in .dsh/run-deck/run.json, using the VS Code tasks.json vocabulary. Click to run, click again to stop; each button carries live status, and the bar has three label densities plus a pinnable output card.
description.zh: 输入框上方的启动条：按项目 .dsh/run-deck/run.json 里声明的条目各生成一个按钮（字段沿用 VS Code 的 tasks.json），点一下跑、再点停；每条带实时状态，另有三种按钮密度与可钉住的输出卡。

description.en: Intensive-listening practice for media already in the workspace: sentence-by-sentence drills with speed, looping, shadowing and recording, kept sentences with three grades, and a notes.md per episode written back to disk. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把工作区里已有的音视频变成逐句精听练习：变速、循环、跟读与录音，收藏的句子按三档评级，每集写一份 notes.md 回磁盘。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Routes the pnpm and git installs DSH runs through one HTTP proxy, with a switch and an editable address in the Web UI.
description.zh: 让 DSH 执行的 pnpm 与 git 安装走同一个 HTTP 代理，并在 Web 界面里提供开关和可编辑的地址。

description.en: Breaking-change watchdog for MCP tool contracts. Remembers the last three tool generations per MCP server from the live tools/change registry and diffs them: removed tools, dropped parameters, accepted-type changes, new required fields and narrowed enums are graded breaking; default and constraint changes are warnings; additions are info. A quiet-window debounce absorbs mcp-client re-sync churn, so first connections and reconnects never false-alarm. Reports through a transcript notice plus `/mcp-diff`, caches snapshots under `$DSH_HOME/mcp-schema-cache` (last 3 versions), reads the registry only and writes no other state.
description.zh: MCP 工具契约的破坏性变更预警。从运行中的 tools/change 注册表里，为每个 MCP server 记住最近三代工具定义并做结构化 diff：工具删除、参数删除、可接受类型收窄、新增必填、枚举收窄记为 breaking；默认值与约束变化记为 warning；新增工具/可选参数记为 info。静默窗口防抖吸收 mcp-client 的重新同步抖动，首次连接和重连都不会误报。通过会话通知加 `/mcp-diff` 输出，快照存 `$DSH_HOME/mcp-schema-cache`（每个 server 保留 3 个版本），只读注册表，不写其他状态。

description.en: Adds external agents to DeepSeek Harness as model rows - seven presets covering GLM (ZCode), MiniMax, Claude, Codex, Grok, Cursor and Qoder - together with the browser-side roster, per-provider quota pills and a self-report health route. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把外部 agent 以模型行的方式接进 DeepSeek Harness：七条预设覆盖 GLM（ZCode）、MiniMax、Claude、Codex、Grok、Cursor 与 Qoder，并附带浏览器侧的名册、各家配额胶囊和一个自报健康路由。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DeepSeek web-style mode: composer toggles for deep think and web search, a DeepSeek agent preset, and per-session web_search gating.
description.zh: DeepSeek 网页版对齐模式：输入框深度思考与联网搜索开关、deepseek 预设、按会话门控 web_search。

description.en: Puts a channel capsule and a live status dot on the one session each IM channel is currently driving in the sidebar; zero dependencies, about 7 kB. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在左侧会话列表标出「哪个会话正被 IM 通道驱动」：一行胶囊加一个实时状态点；零依赖、约 7 kB。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Live host memory and heap-ceiling meter: a sidebar pill showing RSS, the percentage of the V8 heap limit, and the ceiling itself. It reads the host process directly, so a stock host reports its ~4 GB limit and a high-memory host reports whatever it was launched with.
description.zh: 实时内存与堆上限监控：侧边栏小条显示常驻内存、占 V8 堆上限的百分比，以及上限本身。它直接读取宿主进程，因此原版宿主显示约 4 GB 上限，高内存宿主则显示启动时的真实上限。

description.en: Adds a deep-research agent preset with the DeepSight methodology skill bundled, plus three tools that set an evidence contract, audit claim tiers along the provenance chain of every action item, and summarize the persisted ledger. Delivery is blocked while an action basis derives from unverified estimates or an unresolved conflict.
description.zh: 新增一个深度研究 Agent 预设，内置 DeepSight 方法论技能；另附三个工具，分别用于设定证据契约、沿行动依据的来源链审计结论档位、汇总已落盘账本。行动依据若源自未验证估算或尚未闭环的冲突，交付会被拦截。

description.en: Puts every tool in a drawer: everyday tools stay on the desk, and everything else is fetched on demand through find_tool, describe_tool and use_tool.
description.zh: 把工具都收进抽屉：常用工具留在桌面，其余需要时再通过 find_tool、describe_tool、use_tool 取出。

description.en: Scans JavaScript for code smells, grades cleanliness from A to E, and maps most findings to a refactoring technique from Fowler's catalog.
description.zh: 扫描 JavaScript 代码味道并给出整洁度评分，并把大多数问题对应到《重构》里的具体手法。

description.en: Replaces the composer model seat with a searchable provider and model table: per-model discount chips, live balance and plan rows, channel credits, and a per-session subagent switch.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型选择位换成可搜索的服务商与模型表格，含逐模型折扣倍率、实时余额与套餐进度、渠道积分，以及每会话的启用子任务开关。

description.en: Skills importer for DSH: scans the WorkBuddy skills folder, normalizes and de-duplicates skill ids, then copies the skills you pick into the DSH skills directory from a Settings panel. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 技能目录导入 DSH：扫描技能文件夹、归一化并去重技能 id，在设置面板里勾选后复制到 DSH 技能目录。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Linux dsh web self-updater: checks npm at startup and every 24 hours, then installs the newer @deepseek-ai/dsh release and restarts dsh web by itself.
description.zh: Linux dsh web 自更新插件：启动时与每 24 小时检查 npm，确认后安装新版 @deepseek-ai/dsh 并自动重启 dsh web。

description.en: Check cloud model API costs at a glance: switch which vendor the sidebar cell shows by hand, and adjust how often it refreshes. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 一个可以快速查看云端模型api费用的插件，支持手动切换厂商，支持调节刷新频率。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A composer button, an /optimize command and an optimize_prompt tool that rewrite a prompt into a numbered specification, leaving variables, code blocks, URLs and numbers unchanged.
description.zh: 输入框按钮、/optimize 命令与 optimize_prompt 工具，把提示词改写成分层编号的规格说明，并保持变量、代码块、URL 与数字不变。

description.en: Codex-style project-free sessions: each new session in the default workspace creates and enters a date-grouped folder (default-workspace/YYYY-MM-DD/session-id) via native working-directory events, with a toggleable work/ and outputs/ directory convention.
description.zh: 仿照 Codex 的无项目会话：默认工作区中的每段新会话首次运行时自动创建并进入按日期分组的独立文件夹（默认工作区/YYYY-MM-DD/会话ID），内置可开关的 work/ 与 outputs/ 目录约定。

description.en: Create editable bead patterns with local conversion, project storage, exports, and optional experimental image assistance. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中生成和编辑拼豆图纸，支持本地转换、作品保存、导出及可选的 AI 测试功能。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Audit and clean stale caches, orphan sessions, PPID=1 MCP processes, and broken configs across AI coding agents with reversible trash. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 扫描并清理 Claude Code、OpenCode、Codex、DSH 等 AI 编程工具的冗余缓存、孤儿会话、PPID=1 僵尸 MCP 进程与失效配置，支持可逆回收站还原。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Batch and per-Bot model switching for DS Bot teams: move every Bot to one model at once, or set one row per Bot, through DS Bot own api/bot update-bot endpoint instead of writing state.json.
description.zh: 给 DS Bot 团队批量或逐个切换模型：一次把全队切到同一模型，或每个 Bot 单独一行设置；写入走 DS Bot 自己的 api/bot update-bot 端点，不直接改 state.json。

description.en: DSH sidebar plugin console: inspect plugin information, session sources and tool ownership, preview context content and the impact of disabling a plugin, and customize prompts and tools for the first request.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏插件控制台：查看 DSH 插件信息、会话来源与工具归属，预演上下文内容与插件禁用影响，并支持提示词/工具定制首次请求。

description.en: DeepSeek QuickAsk: a DeepSeek-native floating assistant for Harness with a global hotkey, workspace/session/model/permission controls, session-aware main-window navigation, optional floating ball, and local image attachments.
description.zh: DeepSeek 随手问：DeepSeek 原生风格的 Harness 悬浮助手。支持全局快捷键、工作区/会话/模型/权限控制、跳转到对应主窗口会话、可选悬浮球，以及本地图片选择、拖入和粘贴。

description.en: Companion for the FoloToy AI Passport cyber badge firmware: edit the pixel avatar, profile, status lines, skins, memos and answers in a local editor or through agent tools, and sync them to the device over the LAN.
description.zh: AI Passport 赛博工牌的电脑端：在本机编辑页或对话里修改像素头像、资料、状态大字、皮肤、便签和答案，通过局域网同步到设备。

description.en: Runs commands on remote hosts over SSH in-process, so password auth works without a terminal. Remote host passwords are read from a local hosts file in plain text (or from an environment variable named by passwordEnv).
description.zh: 通过 SSH 在远程主机执行命令，支持密码认证，无需终端。远程主机的密码从本地 hosts 文件以明文读取（或从 passwordEnv 指定的环境变量读取）。

description.en: MCP server panel for DeepSeek Harness: reads MCP servers from nine existing agent config files (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex TOML, Gemini CLI, ZCode, pi, .agents and .dsh), merges them per project, and requires approval bound to a SHA-256 fingerprint before a repository-declared server runs.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器管理面板：读取 Claude Code、Cursor、VS Code、Codex TOML、Gemini CLI、ZCode、pi、.agents、.dsh 九种已有配置，按项目合并；仓库声明的服务器需批准后运行，批准绑定 SHA-256 指纹。

description.en: Runs a development task in an isolated copy of the project: Solo runs one agent, Swarm runs three agents in the same copy that message each other via send_message/list_agents; the resulting diff is shown per file and only the files you approve are applied. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在项目的隔离副本里执行开发任务：Solo 模式一个 agent 独立完成，Swarm 模式三个 agent 在同一副本里通过 send_message/list_agents 互相通信；结果按文件展示 diff，只应用你批准的文件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Per-turn task progress for DSH: a node rail and expandable list above the composer, a gray progress glyph in a completed reply footer, and a Right Sidebar tab listing every node as a card, driven by the model report_progress calls and a side-channel evaluator.
description.zh: DSH 会话内的本轮任务进度：输入框上方有节点轨道和可展开列表，完成回复底部有灰色进度图标，右侧边栏按时间顺序用卡片显示全部节点；节点来自模型的 report_progress 调用和旁路评估。

description.en: Music player and song source. Plays a local music folder, YT Music and bilibili directly; searches Spotify, KKBOX and Apple Music and reads their links, then either plays a matching version found in the local library or on YouTube, or has the official desktop player on the same computer play the song and relays its sound live. Registers itself as a music source for the dsh-discord-cyberfriend plugin. Controlling and relaying official players is Windows only and off by default.
description.zh: 音乐播放器与点歌来源。可直接播放本地音乐文件夹、YT Music 与 bilibili；可搜索 Spotify、KKBOX、Apple Music 并读取它们的链接，然后改播本地音乐库或 YouTube 上的同一首，或让同一台电脑上的官方播放器播放并实时转送声音。会登记成 dsh-discord-cyberfriend 插件的点歌来源。控制与转送官方播放器仅限 Windows，默认关闭。

description.en: Turns decisions a doctor has already made into a patient-readable after-visit guide: one-sentence diagnosis, medication table (name / how to take / for how long / caution), diet & activity, follow-up, and when to seek urgent care. A hard-coded template filled with the input verbatim: no model-written medical text, no advice, no diagnosis, no medication recommendation; a doctor must review the output before it reaches a patient.
description.zh: 把医生已经做出的决定排成患者看得懂的《您的就诊须知》：诊断一句话、用药表格（药名/怎么吃/吃多久/注意事项）、饮食与活动、复查、什么情况需要立即就医。模板硬编码、只填医生原话，不生成任何医学表述，不给建议、诊断或用药推荐；交付患者前须医生审核。

description.en: Reviews tool usage across sessions and optionally hides unused discovery tools per workspace.
description.zh: 统计跨会话工具使用情况，并可按项目隐藏未使用的发现类工具。
